title: Chewi Theorem 8.3.1: simultaneous f-divergence dissipation
source_anchor: Sinho Chewi, Log-Concave Sampling (2026-08-09), Theorem 8.3.1, printed p. 219 / PDF p. 230: if two probability-law curves satisfy partial_t mu_t = L_t^* mu_t and partial_t nu_t = L_t^* nu_t for generators satisfying the diffusion chain rule, then the time derivative of D_f(mu_t||nu_t) is the negative integral of f''(dmu_t/dnu_t) Gamma_t(dmu_t/dnu_t) against nu_t.
target_statement: Formalize the source theorem as a measure-level statement whose left side is Chewi Definition 1.5.5 f-divergence, whose density ratio is Samplinglib's canonical Radon-Nikodym representative, and whose dynamics are expressed by a time-dependent weak-adjoint generator contract. Preserve the source's single diffusion-chain-rule assumption rather than permanently assuming both equivalent formulations independently, and expose any regularity needed to make f'' and differentiation meaningful through the semantic-fidelity/denoising layer.
